qa_pairs.question: How do users access visualization capabilities on the Graham cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can access visualization on the Graham cluster through dedicated visualization nodes, which are available at gra-vdi.alliancecan.ca and only allow VNC connections.

qa_pairs.question: What is the current status of the Graham cluster's capacity?
qa_pairs.answer: The Graham cluster's capacity was reduced in early 2025 to make space for the installation of the new Nibi cluster.

qa_pairs.question: What types of GPUs are available on the remaining Graham nodes as of February 2025?
qa_pairs.answer: As of February 2025, the remaining Graham nodes include NVIDIA V100 Volta (32GB HBM2), NVIDIA T4 Turing (16GB GDDR6), and NVIDIA A100 Ampere GPUs.
